newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products-Mostly steady, gasoline in neutra.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products-Mostly steady, gasoline in neutra.

text.p: NWE oil products ended mostly firmer on Monday but fuel oil showed some weakness.
Fuel oil slipped under pressure from poor demand and active swaps selling. Low sulphur cargo prices weakened to a notional $85/$86 and high sulph barges to $81/$82 fob ARA.
Naphtha ended firmer as traders said any negative impact from Skikda's loading changes had only a short-term influence.
Gasoline closed steady as traders waited for clues to the strength of the peak driving season and whether sellers would dump inventory into the barge market due to the backwardation.
Gas oil was very slow with a couple of the main players out of the market. Premiums for all grades held firm.
